risk_note: RV2 (platform events / queue wiring; notification consumer). FU-SETTLE-ADJ-NOTIFY part C plus FU-CLAWBACK-NOTIFY (orchestrator D10-773, D10-791; CT-26za merged #2589). One consumer notification-clawback (queue evt.notification-clawback, worker only) subscribes to order.clawed_back and order.settle_adjusted and writes inbox + notify_logs in the event transaction, push after commit gated by the service switch (pattern of B1-12u withdrawal-result-message). CLAWBACK bodies per 08 BR-TEXT-09 (negative amount format), titles inbox.title.CLAWBACK.self / .promo; SETTLE_ADJUSTED bodies per D10-773 with {amount} = absolute value of the reduction (D10-791), titles inbox.title.SETTLE_ADJUSTED.*; invite rows carry no reason or order data and route to the wallet ledger, self / share to order detail; only user_available beneficiaries; settle_adjusted ignores adjust_fen >= 0 and other buckets; dedupe keys {order_key}:{uid}:{role}:CLAWBACK:{rights_event_id} and :SETTLE_ADJ:{settle_seq}. No money is moved (messages only). admin-channels catalog gains SETTLE_ADJUSTED. Frozen events / queue contract tests changed only in subscriber / queue counts and lists (B1-12u precedent), two unchanged limits.test.ts cases red_exempt per the ledger. The settle_adjusted publisher is a separate task after B2-04zi. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml #21; D10-772).

Second fresh independent Claude re-reviewing the same diff per D10-775 ② (both must pass), pass, no findings.
